faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery takes 3–5 business days inside Lahore and 5–7 business days for the rest of Pakistan. Orders placed before 4pm are dispatched the same day.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: Returns are accepted within 7 days of delivery if the product is unopened and in original packaging. Refunds are processed within 5 business days after we receive the item.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), bank transfer, Easypaisa, JazzCash, and debit/credit cards.

faqs.question: What are your shop timings?
faqs.answer: We are open Monday to Saturday, 10am–8pm. Friday break is 1pm–2:30pm. We are closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Where are you located?
faqs.answer: Our store is in Lahore. The exact address is shared via WhatsApp when you place an order, or you can ask here and our team will guide you.

faqs.question: Do you have any discounts or offers?
faqs.answer: Yes! We run weekend sales (up to 20% off) and give a 10% discount on first orders with the code AY10. Bulk/reseller discounts are also available.

faqs.question: Are your products original?
faqs.answer: Yes, all products at Ay Cosmetics are 100% original and imported through official distributors. Every item has a scratch-verified authenticity code.
